cohort.interpretation: Unused VALID contexts, not independent unseen news; original target identities can overlap earlier development groups.

exposure: Reused development group contexts and target identities; not untouched confirmation. Prior final TEST outcomes known, but no TEST access or tuning in this run.
checkpoint_scope: One official author state; three capture-noise repetitions and separately fitted downstream models, not three independent author models.

settings.fit: one exact float64 zero-intercept ridge solve per seed
settings.policy: best pool prediction above threshold; otherwise identity
settings.random: uniform fixed-seed draw from the same proposal pool; matched arm uses learned activation, always arm ignores activation
settings.preserve: all original node features, target and injected-to-injected blocks, candidate identities/order, every injected physical degree and total budgets
settings.training_importance: One row per sampled legal swap; proposal sampling is uniform over legal triples within a case, not uniform across all graph edges.

qualification.rule: Both contrasts mean > 0, all three differences > 0, and nominal paired t95 lower > 0; otherwise no reliable improvement established.
qualification.no_choice_cases: Identity retained in every denominator; no replacement or favorable case filtering.
qualification.uncertainty: Three conditional repeats, correlated target occurrences and prior adaptive development; nominal seed interval only.
